rows.grounds: optative third singular active of laṅghayati fused with negative na

items.question: May a Kaula practitioner cross the guru's bathing water or shadow at any time?
premises: Guru's bathing water must be protected.
Guru's shadow must not be crossed.
items.inference: The practitioner must never cross either the guru's bathing water or shadow.
uncertainties: The exact ritual scope of laṅghayenna remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Never cross the guru's bathing water or shadow.
